notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
A giant thank you to everyone who came and played Riposte! at The Seattle Indies Expo 2022!!  It was wonderful to see so many people playing in-person.  

The feedback was great and much appreciated, we even found a previously unseen bug!

Cheers!
-Aaron

[u]PATCH NOTES[/u]

BUG FIXES:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the Parrying Dagger could get stuck while parrying.
[/list]

BALANCE CHANGES:
[list]
[*]Kite Shield ability cooldown increased from 2s to 2.5s.
[*]Kite Shield max distance from character increased from 4.4 to 4.5.
[*]Kite Shield deflection times increased by 10%.
[*]Parrying Dagger ability cooldown increased from 1.5s to 2s.
[*]Parry Dagger ability lock up time decreased from 1.25s to 1s.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
First post-launch update adding achievements, small balance tweaks, and updated soundFX.

The achievements range from trivial, to a little difficult, to pretty tough :D.

notes.title: Experimental Solo vs AI Mode Added for Launch
notes.content:
With everyone stuck at home we decided to move-up and include the single-player 1vAI mode for launch!  Face off against a gauntlet of back-to-back AI opponents, powered by neural networks and trained in over a million matches.

Is fighting 10 opponents in a single life fair? Not at all, so good luck!
